reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Setting up the app was almost impossible with all the service errors. Every page takes forever to load—if at all. Once i finally got through setup, there’s service errors loading every page, photos will not upload either from the camera or importing from photos. The app either times out, has a service error, or crashes every time. Dark mode also makes the app unusable as menus all have a white background and white text. Really disappointing since this app has features that a lot of apps don’t have. Looks like it may not longer be maintained. Waiting to get a refund from Apple.

reviews.title: Invasive privacy policy
reviews.text:
I purchased the app, only to find a terms of service forced on users that gives the app makers the right to take my photos and use them as they see fit.  Obviously these are sensitive photos, and in my opinion this is overreaching.

The text of the terms includes:

“You grant us the right and license to use, modify, perform, display, reproduce and distribute such Content.”

reviews.text: App seems great so far, but it does not appear to have native camera support, so I cannot use the timer to take photos. The app is great as long as you’re cool with its limitations. Hope these items get addressed.

reviews.title: Very Useful for weight loss progress
reviews.text: I’m doing a lot of cardio and weight training and it’s a bit difficult to monitor your progress by weight. I was really demotivated by the number on the scale. But when I was able to add my pictures and doing a couple of comparisons, I was surprised by how good it works! I’ve just started using it but this really provides a much needed motivation boost.
reviews.author: moni2804

reviews.title: Finally!!
reviews.text: Awesome app!! Ive been searching for an app where I can keep track of my body transformation and this definitely is the perfect tool. I usually do 3 months of heavy workouts including cardio, weightlifting and some complementary activities. These 3 months sessions are supervised by my personal trainer and often I boost them with some supplements, but I have never been able to tell if they really pay off!! I will be using this tool to find out if its worth the sacrifice and the investment or if i should just continue my regular routine...
reviews.author: Gdipino

reviews.title: Super useful for my training
reviews.text: I’m an avid fitness apps user and monitor everything from weight to steps taken. Never have I found such a useful way to “truly visualize” my progress, as the app’s description states.
